name: Stardander Revenant
source: Griselda and Dianthus are both students at Stardander School for Witches, but they could not be more different. When Griselda nearly dies during a fae attack and Dianthus retreats into isolation, their lives - and fates - become entwined. Can Griselda bring Dianthus back to the “living world?”
translation: 格里塞尔达和石竹都是斯塔丹德女巫学校的学生，但她们却截然不同。当格里塞尔达在妖精袭击中差点丧命，而石竹则陷入孤立之中时，他们的生活和命运交织在一起。格里塞尔达能否将石竹带回“生命世界”？
